fi-canthigaster-margaritata.title: Pearl Toby
fi-canthigaster-margaritata.summary: A small toby puffer with pearly spots. Often learns to beg for food.
rows: About 4¾ in (LiveAquaria max size); wild record 11.5 cm (4.5 in) TL (FishBase)
No. Picks at corals and small invertebrates
Carnivore. Mysis, krill, silversides, clams and chopped crustaceans
Western Indian Ocean: restricted to the Red Sea and Gulf of Aden
notes: Move puffers in a container, not a net. Do not make them puff up.
Needs about 50 gal with live rock to explore.
warn: May bother fish that are smaller or less aggressive.

fi-arothron-manilensis.title: Narrow-Lined Puffer
fi-arothron-manilensis.summary: A puffer with thin dark lines along a pale body; lives in mangroves, seagrass and reef flats in the wild.
rows: About 12 in (LiveAquaria max size); wild record 31 cm (12.2 in) TL (FishBase)
Carnivore. Squid, krill, clams and other meaty foods; hard shells help keep teeth worn
Western Pacific: Borneo, Philippines, and northwest Australia to Samoa, north to the Ryukyu Islands, south to New South Wales, Australia and Tonga
notes: Keep with fish of similar size and temperament.

fi-canthigaster-valentini.title: Valentini Saddle Puffer
fi-canthigaster-valentini.summary: A small white toby with dark saddles.
rows: About 4 in (LiveAquaria max size); wild record 11 cm (4.3 in) TL (FishBase)
Omnivore. Varied meaty foods, including hard-shelled shrimp to wear down teeth
Indo-Pacific: Red Sea south to Durban, South Africa and east to the Tuamoto Islands, north to southern Japan, south to Lord Howe Island
warn: Parts of its flesh are poisonous.

fi-arothron-nigropunctatus.title: Dogface Puffer
fi-arothron-nigropunctatus.summary: A medium-size puffer for fish-only tanks.
rows: About 13 in (LiveAquaria max size); wild record 33 cm (13 in) TL (FishBase)
Tolerates other puffers that are not more aggressive than it
Carnivore. Squid, krill, clams and hard-shelled shrimp to wear down teeth
Indo-Pacific: East Africa to Micronesia and Samoa, north to southern Japan, south to New South Wales

fi-canthigaster-solandri.title: Blue Spot Puffer
fi-canthigaster-solandri.summary: A small toby covered in blue spots.
rows: About 4½ in (LiveAquaria max size); wild record 12.1 cm (4.8 in) TL (FishBase)
Omnivore. Varied meaty foods, including hard-shelled items to wear down teeth

fi-canthigaster-rostrata.title: Caribbean Sharpnose Puffer
fi-canthigaster-rostrata.summary: A small puffer from the western Atlantic and Caribbean with blue lines radiating from its eyes. Active and curious, but a nipper.
rows: About 4.5 in (Top Shelf adult size); wild record 12 cm (4.7 in) TL (FishBase)
Omnivore. Foods: frozen mysis shrimp, enriched brine shrimp, chopped clam, marine pellets, algae sheets, small snails
Western Central Atlantic: South Carolina, USA and Bermuda to Tobago and the Lesser Antilles
notes: Nips coral polyps, clam mantles and fan worms, and harasses slow fish such as seahorses and pipefish.
